subject: Price synchronization and runtime fallthrough for VegaHealth
messages:
From: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@vegahealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor quote comparison: can Redwood match?

Hi Karthik,

We just received a formal offer from OrbitAI for VegaHealth — they quoted a 35% discount on API usage for the first 12 months, plus a $200k migration allowance and a 6-week white-glove onboarding. They also included a note about a custom runtime bundle that reduces egress on long-context workloads (they framed it as a performance credit).

Before we escalate, can Redwood provide a comparable commercial for parity? Two specific asks from procurement:
- A headline price match (percent off list) for year 1.
- Confirmation on egress/egress pricing and whether fallbacks to smaller runtime shapes would change SLA guarantees.

I attached OrbitAI's quote for reference. We need a play we can take to our CFO this week.

[Attachment: OrbitAI_quote_July2026.pdf]

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Jamie
Jamie Cole
Director of Cloud Platforms, VegaHealth
jamie.cole@vegahealth.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@vegahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor quote comparison: can Redwood match?

Hi Jamie — appreciate the heads up and the OrbitAI quote.

Short answer: yes, we can put together a structured match that keeps VegaHealth on Redwood with minimal disruption. Two commercial options we typically surface for deals like this:

1) Headline match + migration credit
   - Match the headline effective discount (we can go to ~32% for year 1)
   - Offer a migration credit applied against the first 3 invoices (amounts *subject to scope*)

2) Less headline discount + operational credits
   - Slightly smaller headline discount (mid-high 20s) + a larger onboarding and dedicated engineering window (4-6 weeks) to ensure performance parity on long-context workloads.

Before I lock numbers, I want Connor to confirm the runtime fallthrough behavior you asked about and Laura to confirm where this sits in your renewal timeline. I attached a quick econ workbook to sketch the two options.

Next steps I propose:
- Connor: validate whether our fallback to smaller instance sizes will preserve p99 latency targets for VegaHealth’s 8k context workloads.
- Laura: confirm whether Vega needs a 12-month fixed price or prefers a commit-based structure.

I’ll hold a placeholder for a 30-minute call tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[Attachment: redwood-switch-econ.xlsx]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: VegaHealth concession recommendation (draft)

Laura / Connor — quick internal note (please reply to thread). Jamie asked us to respond with a matched/near-match commercial this week. I sketched two concrete offers in the attached MAAP and the econ workbook:

Proposal A (Aggressive retain)
- 32% off published API list for 12 months
- $120k migration credit (applied across first 3 invoices)
- 6-week prioritized onboarding + 3 dedicated runbook days from Solutions Eng
- Performance SLA: maintain 99.5% p99 latency target for their primary workload; fallthrough rules allowed with pre-approved instance shapes

Proposal B (Operational-first)
- 26% off published API list for 12 months
- $200k onboarding credit focused on dedicated runtime tuning (node sizing/quantization)
- 8-week migration plan and guaranteed 4-week fallback mitigation support

Connor: two questions for you — can you confirm the "fallthrough" guarantee (if we force a fallback to smaller GPU shapes under capacity pressure, do we have a safe SLA statement we can promise?), and how much effort to guarantee no quality regression on their finetuning + long-context workloads?

I recommend we aim for Proposal A as the commercial starting point; it balances headline parity and budget impact while giving us runway to negotiate technical concessions.

[Attachment: VegaHealth_MAAP_v2.pdf]

Karthik

From: procurement@vegahealth.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor quote comparison: can Redwood match?

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for the quick response. Procurement here — a couple of clarifying points before we escalate to finance:

1) Egress and runtime pricing: OrbitAI's note includes reduced egress for token-streaming when running their "long-context bundle." Can Redwood confirm whether the proposed discount includes any egress reductions, or if egress will be billed per standard list rates?

2) Fallthrough behavior: We need a contractual assurance that if Redwood routes traffic to an alternative runtime (smaller GPU shape or shared-pool fallback) during capacity spikes, our SLAs (p99 latency and availability) will be maintained or there is a documented remediation (credits/rollback).

3) Compliance artifacts: please attach SOC 2 Type II attestation and a standard DPA. Also, we prefer to have DocuSign-ready redlines for quick legal turnaround.

Please send a consolidated commercial + legal packet; our CFO wants to see a single page economics summary and a short implementation timeline.

Best,
Vega Procurement
procurement@vegahealth.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@vegahealth.com>, procurement@vegahealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor quote comparison: can Redwood match? — formal offer

Jamie / Procurement team — thanks for the clarity. Below is the consolidated package Redwood is prepared to move forward with; I’ve prioritized simplicity for legal review and finance sign-off.

Commercial summary (single-line)
- Effective headline: 32% off Redwood published API list pricing for the first 12 months (applies to text-gen and chat routes in their current config).
- Migration credit: $120,000 applied across the first 3 invoices; refundable credit if go-live is delayed past 120 days.

Runtime fallthrough guarantees
- We will provide a documented fallthrough policy that allows routing to smaller instance shapes only under prespecified, time-limited capacity shortfalls.
- If fallthrough is invoked, we guarantee p99 latency remediation: either (a) credits equivalent to 10% of monthly bill for the period of SLA degradation, or (b) an automatic rollback to the prior model variant within 48 hours where feasible. These are formal callouts we can insert into the MSA.

Egress pricing
- Egress remains at standard list rates. However, for VegaHealth’s long-context routes we will include a one-time optimization credit (applied as part of the $120k migration credit) intended to offset higher egress during the cutover period.

Compliance & legal
- Attached: SOC 2 Type II attestation (link) and a DPA template.
- DocuSign: I’ve prepared a redline-ready term sheet and uploaded it to DocuSign for quick signature. Link below.

Attachments / Links
- SOC 2 Type II: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bVegaTechPlan
- Commercial workbook: redwood-switch-econ.xlsx (attached)
- MAAP: VegaHealth_MAAP_v2.pdf (attached)
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/9f4b-vega-docusign
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-78321

Next steps
1) If acceptable, sign the DocuSign term sheet (link above) — legal can accept the fallthrough credits language as drafted.
2) Connor and our Solutions Eng team will schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive this week to validate runtime shapes and finalize the performance runbook.
3) Laura and I will align on invoice application for the migration credit and a go-live milestone calendar.

We’re happy to be flexible on the precise mechanics (credit timing, rollback window), but this is the package we believe strikes the right balance between VegaHealth’s near-term economics and our operational risk.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
